text_simplified: Parents must choose toys for their children that develop intelligence, physical skills, and mental abilities, while avoiding violent toys or those that harm psychological and physical health. They should also monitor playtime and guide children toward beneficial activities that reinforce religious and social values.

review_defects.why: The adjective 'المناسبة' (suitable) is omitted in the body text, so the English does not specify that the toys should be suitable, although the title includes it.
